Low Food Variety Threshold
Colonists with lower food variety than this will get negative mood effects. 30% by default.
High Food Variety Threshold
Colonists with higher food variety than this will get positive mood effects. 60% by default.
Number of latest meals to count
The food variety need level will be calculated by counting among this number of meals consumed. Default is 7 latest meals.
Number of latest ingredients to count
The food variety need level will be calculated by counting among this number of ingredients consumed. Default is 7 latest ingredients.
Number of ingredient stack per meal (requires reload)
By default, vanilla meals start deleting "common" ingredients after 3 ingredients. This allows you to increase that limit. Requires a mod reload to take effect.
